title: Coverage Pocket — Rapid Liaison List (2029-08-21)
content:
Purpose: Quick roster for ad-hoc coverage pockets — small, temporary owner lists to stand up rapid liaison/triage for short windows (hours→days). Usable by product-ops and SRE to patch gaps during holiday surges, audits, or one-off customer escalations.

Columns: Owner | Role | Region/Scope | Primary Contact (email) | Backup Contact (email) | Availability Window (UTC) | Core skills / reason assigned | Notes / handoff pointers | Last verified

Aisha Patel | SRE Oncall Lead | Global routing & fallbacks | aisha.patel@redwood.ai | miguel.rodriguez@redwood.ai | 2029-08-22 06:00–18:00 UTC | routing policies, canary rollbacks | Primary for runtime fallback activation; has runbook link in Slack #ops-runbooks | 2029-09-01
Miguel Rodriguez | Field Liaison (APAC) | APAC region customers & partners | miguel.rodriguez@redwood.ai | priyamenon@redwood.ai | 2029-08-22 00:00–12:00 UTC | partner SLAs, network peering | Handles partner comms for APAC cloud region; escalate to infra-eng if capacity issues persist | 2029-08-30
Claire Zhang | Product Ops / Rollouts | Hosted API feature toggles | claire.zhang@redwood.ai | ethan.brooks@redwood.ai | 2029-08-22 12:00–23:59 UTC | rollout gating, toggle reversion | Tracks canary buckets; quick-check script at /scripts/canary-check.sh | 2029-09-02
Ethan Brooks | Dedicated Capacity SME | Dedicated pools and reservations | ethan.brooks@redwood.ai | aisha.patel@redwood.ai | 2029-08-22 07:00–19:00 UTC | quota adjustments, burst policies | Can open emergency capacity window; keep CFO notified for charges >$5k/day | 2029-08-28
Priya Menon | Customer Success Escalation | Enterprise customers (EMEA) | priyamenon@redwood.ai | claire.zhang@redwood.ai | 2029-08-22 08:00–20:00 UTC | contract SLAs, legal notices | Primary for any customer-impacting outages; owns customer comms template in docs | 2029-09-03
Samir Gupta | Security Watch (on-call) | Security triage & incident classing | samir.gupta@redwood.ai | elena.morales@redwood.ai | 2029-08-22 00:00–23:59 UTC | incident validation, breach assessment | Triage if suspicious traffic or keys exposed; use security-incident-runbook v2 | 2029-08-25
Jules Carter | Observability Signal | Metrics/alert triage | jules.carter@redwood.ai | nora.liu@redwood.ai | 2029-08-22 06:00–18:00 UTC | dashboards, anomaly triage | Ensure APM tracing is enabled for affected routes; drop link to snapshot in #ops | 2029-08-29
Nora Liu | Console / Rollback Support | Console and rollouts tooling | nora.liu@redwood.ai | samir.gupta@redwood.ai | 2029-08-22 10:00–22:00 UTC | toggle ops, rollback scripts | Coordinates with Claire on runtime toggle reverts; owns the disable-hot-route playbook | 2029-09-01

Quick how-to / usage notes:
- This sheet is intentionally compact: copy row(s) into an incident channel and pin.
- Verify backups before handing off: call backup and confirm acknowledgment.
- If a liaison needs to escalate outside their scope, add an escalation row and ping the next-team point.
- After the pocket ends, mark "Last verified" with end date and append a 1-line postmortem note in Notes.

Recent one-off uses:
- 2029-08-22: short APAC partner audit (Miguel led partner comms; no SLA breaches).
- 2029-07-11: holiday surge (Claire/Jules triaged routing hotspots; capacity scaled via Ethan).

Open questions / next steps:
- Should we add a "cost-approver" column for any capacity-per-request > $2k/day? (proposed: Finance on-call)
- Consider automating verification pings (Slack bot) that update "Last verified" once backup replies.

Revision history: Drafted by Aisha Patel 2029-08-21; added Claire & Miguel rows 2029-08-22; last sanity pass 2029-09-03 by Priya Menon.
